Overview

LLP Registration in Ghaziabad

A great many Ghaziabad businesses are run by two or more family members or partners under a traditional partnership deed, with unlimited personal liability. An LLP keeps the partnership's flexibility — profit sharing, roles and capital set freely in the agreement — while protecting personal assets and giving the firm a separate legal identity that banks and corporate customers recognise.

An existing partnership firm in Ghaziabad can also be converted into an LLP. Whether you start fresh or convert, the LLP is registered online with the MCA; we prepare the LLP Agreement on Uttar Pradesh stamp paper, sort out the address proof for your Ghaziabad premises and file Form 3 in time.

Ghaziabad specifics

What is specific to Ghaziabad

  • ROC Kanpur handles the LLP's annual Form 11 and Form 8 and any changes in partners.
  • LLP Agreement stamped under Uttar Pradesh rates, based on the partners' contribution, and filed in Form 3 within 30 days.
  • Shop, godown or industrial premises in Sahibabad, Raj Nagar or Mohan Nagar can be the registered office with the owner's NOC and a recent PVVNL bill.
  • Converting a partnership firm: all partners of the firm must become partners of the LLP, and the firm's registration with the Registrar of Firms is referenced in the conversion form.
  • Local licences — UP Shops & Establishment, Nagar Nigam trade licence or Factory Licence — are separate from MCA registration; we tell you which apply.

For the full legal detail — eligibility, benefits, comparison tables and law — see the main LLP Registration guide. This page covers what changes when your registered office is in Ghaziabad.

Checklist

Documents required in Ghaziabad

For each partner

  • PAN card and Aadhaar card
  • Passport, Voter ID or Driving Licence
  • Latest bank statement or utility bill (not older than 2 months)
  • Passport-size photograph
  • Email ID and mobile number

Ghaziabad registered office

  • Latest electricity bill (PVVNL), gas, telephone or mobile bill — not older than 2 months
  • NOC from the property owner
  • Rent agreement, if rented
  • GDA allotment letter, sale deed or Nagar Nigam property tax receipt, if self-owned
Step by step

LLP Registration process in Ghaziabad

Digital Signature Certificates Day 1–2

Class-3 DSCs for the designated partners via Aadhaar eKYC.

Name reservation — RUN-LLP Day 2–5

Name and trademark check, then reservation with up to two name choices.

Incorporation filing — FiLLiP Day 5–9

FiLLiP filed with partner details, Ghaziabad registered office proof and consents; DPIN allotted.

Certificate of Incorporation Day 9–12

COI with LLPIN, plus the LLP's PAN and TAN.

LLP Agreement & Form 3 Within 30 days

Agreement drafted and executed on Uttar Pradesh stamp paper of the correct value, then filed in Form 3.

Bank account & registrations After COI

Current account, and GST or MSME registration if needed.

FAQs

LLP Registration in Ghaziabad — common questions

How much does LLP registration cost in Ghaziabad?

Professional fee from ₹1,499, plus Digital Signatures, MCA fees based on contribution and Uttar Pradesh stamp duty on the LLP Agreement. Itemised written quote before any payment.

Can we convert our Ghaziabad partnership firm into an LLP?

Yes. A registered or unregistered partnership firm can be converted under the LLP Act if all its partners become partners of the LLP. Assets, liabilities and contracts vest in the LLP on conversion. We handle the entire process including the post-conversion intimation to the Registrar of Firms.

Is an LLP suitable for a trading or distribution business?

Yes, especially where partners want limited liability without the compliance load of a company. If you expect to exceed ₹40 lakh turnover, budget for the LLP audit; if you expect to raise outside investment, consider a Private Limited Company instead.

Do we have to visit Kanpur for anything?

No. The whole process, including the annual filings, is online through the MCA portal.

What happens if we do not file the LLP Agreement within 30 days?

Form 3 can still be filed, but with additional fees that grow with the delay. We prepare the agreement alongside the incorporation so it is executed and filed on time.
